name: Esprit Cube Anglet: BCBG 2026
information:
Pour les épreuves allant du 4x4 au 7x7, nous utiliserons le nouveau système des Dual Rounds. Merci de prendre connaissance de l'onglet [Dual Round](#80243-dual-rounds) avant de vous inscrire.

----
For events ranging from 4x4 to 7x7, we will be using the new Dual Rounds system. Please review the [Dual Round](#80243-dual-rounds) tab before registering.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjExMTk4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3bf1b605b07da357a2c91babb77e025295716173/Affiche.png)

L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#80047-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule).  

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#80047-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.
